test_save_file_numpy: test the safetensors numpy save_file function to serialize numpy tensors to a .safetensors file on disk
test_load_file_numpy: test the safetensors numpy load_file function to deserialize numpy tensors from a .safetensors file on disk
test_save_numpy_bytes: test the safetensors numpy save function to serialize numpy tensors into an in-memory bytes buffer
test_load_numpy_bytes: test the safetensors numpy load function to deserialize numpy tensors from an in-memory bytes buffer
test_safe_open_torch: test the safetensors safe_open context manager to open and read torch tensors from a .safetensors file
